notablePrerequisites: Twilight Drover has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Twilight Drover by paying {3} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Spirit tokens, adding {4}.
When the Spirits die, Twilight Drover triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on Twilight Drover.
Repeat.
